newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African jobs summit set for October.
newsitem.headline: S.African jobs summit set for October.

text.p: The South African cabinet decided on Wednesday that a Presidential Jobs Summit, bringing together government, labour and business, would be held sometime in October, a statement said.
The statement, issued after a regular fortnightly cabinet meeting, said:

"The cabinet received a report that unemployment represents a major threat to economic growth, development and stability and approved...the convening of a presidential jobs summit which would bring together the social partners to agree on strategies for employment generation with economic growth."
It said the summit would be held in October, without specifying a date.
Around one third of South Africa's workforce of 15 million is unemployed.
